CRITICAL BREACH & DEFENSE RULES

  • Per-Structure Hack: Hacking an outer fence does NOT unlock the house or Grow Room behind it. Players can also jump fences with vehicles/air vehicles—fuse your stash building first.
  • Decoders Do NOT Open Safes: Safes and security cabinets inside a raided house require a Master Key. Always store high-value set pieces in safes, never nightstands.
  • Fuses Survive Repair: When an owner repairs a breached panel (community-reported 7s), full defense restores immediately and locks raiders out. Grab cash/decoders first.
  • Zero Offline Protection: Launder all Dirty Cash before logoff. Uncommon Alarms alert everyone at the location (105y jail, $30k); Epic alerts You ($60k, T2); Legendary alerts You + Clan ($200k, T2).

ZERO-COST DEPLOYMENT PROTOCOL

HOST THIS PAGE FREE ON GITHUB PAGES

This entire militia site—including custom artwork, calculators, checklists, and styling—is packaged as a single self-contained index.html file with zero backend dependencies. You can put it live on a free public URL in under 2 minutes without installing Git or touching a terminal.

OPTION 1: GITHUB PAGES (RECOMMENDED)
  1. Click Download index.html above.
  2. Log in to GitHub and create a new Public repository (e.g., rob-run-militia).
  3. Click uploading an existing file, drag your downloaded index.html in, and click Commit changes.
  4. Go to Settings → Pages → Branch: main / (root) → Save.
  5. Your live site goes up at https://<your-username>.github.io/rob-run-militia/.
OPTION 2: NETLIFY DROP (30 SECONDS)
  1. Click Download index.html and put it inside a new folder named robrun.
  2. Open app.netlify.com/drop.
  3. Drag the folder onto the page—it generates an instant HTTPS link you can share with your Duo/Trio or clan Discord.
OPTION 3: CLOUDFLARE PAGES
  1. Sign in to Cloudflare Pages (free unlimited bandwidth).
  2. Choose Direct Upload or connect your GitHub repo.
  3. Upload the folder containing index.html to get a fast .pages.dev URL.
